host_native_unparsed.note: native rows whose zstd transcript was not parsed; host-reported aggregate usage

notes: Counts are provider-reported usage: response usage for drafting, labelling and adjudication; the host transcript per assistant message (input plus cacheRead plus output) for the native arm; gateway TraceEvent usage for the provider arm.
unlogged_estimate covers drafting responses overwritten by a duplicate concurrent drafting process and one call lost before logging.
Provider-arm calls that timed out at the gateway report no usage; any tokens they consumed are not counted.
host_pilot is one smoke turn; the two first-preregistration pilot host rows are inside host_native and host_provider_only.
